macros.name: floatname
macros.doc: The \floatname command lets you define the float name that LaTeX uses in the caption of a float, i.e., ‘Figure’ for a figure and so on.

macros.name: floatplacement
macros.doc: The \floatplacement command resets the default placement specifier of a class of floats.

macros.name: floatstyle
macros.doc: The \floatstyle command sets a default float style.

macros.name: listof
macros.doc: The \listof command produces a list of all the floats of a given class.

macros.name: newfloat
macros.doc: New kinds of floats may be defined using a \newfloat command analogous to \newtheorem.

macros.name: restylefloat
macros.doc: The \restylefloat command is necessary to change styles for the standard float types figure and table.
